mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_fba_shipment(tenant_id, outbound_id, fba_shipment_id, warehouse_id, amazon_shipment_id, quantity, carton_count, carrier_code, tracking_no, operator_id, shipped_at) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{r.outboundId}, #{r.fbaShipmentId}, #{r.warehouseId}, #{r.amazonShipmentId}, #{r.quantity}, #{r.cartonCount}, #{r.carrierCode}, #{r.trackingNo}, #{r.operatorId}, #{r.shippedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT sync_status FROM wms_fba_shipment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND outbound_id = #{outbound} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_fba_shipment SET sync_status = 'SYNCED', sync_error = NULL, sync_attempts = sync_attempts + 1, synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND outbound_id = #{outbound}
UPDATE wms_fba_shipment SET sync_error = 'FBA 回写失败，可重试', sync_attempts = sync_attempts + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND outbound_id = #{outbound} AND sync_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, outbound_id FROM wms_fba_shipment WHERE sync_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY sync_attempts, shipped_at, tenant_id, outbound_id LIMIT 100
